title: MultiTalent: A Multi-Dataset Approach to Medical Image Segmentation
mechanism: Keep every dataset's classes distinct with one sigmoid head per class on a shared backbone; BCE + batch Dice only on classes a dataset annotates; losses summed; dataset sampling ~ 1/sqrt(n).
evidence: 13 CT datasets: +1.26 Dice average over datasets, largest gains on difficult/cancer classes; as pretraining beat SSL baselines.
adaptation: Keep 24-class softmax head for BenchmarkEL; add sigmoid heads for UCF crack_region/contact/interconnect/corrosion, MSS crack/dark/busbar/noncell, PV-Vision crack. Batches 50% BenchmarkEL; loss per head only on its dataset's cells. Joint from step 0 so no later fine-tune erases the shared encoder.
min_experiment: Arm: joint training with extra heads, 30k steps, 5 seeds, with source conditioning if D36 exp 1 passed. Baseline: house 5-seed. Metrics: clean-49 crack IoU, inactive IoU, E1 crack relF1@2. Kill if crack IoU < +0.012 AND E1 relF1@2 < +0.03 AND inactive IoU not up. ~15 GPU-h.
prior_overlap: BRIEF 5 'UCF-EL supervised pretraining of the encoder' was sequential pretrain then house fine-tune that erased the encoder; joint training is explicitly not closed

alt_notes.adaptation: Same run family as the partial-label loss. BenchmarkEL, MultiSolSegment (independent crack, busbar, dark) and UCF-EL in one model, with per-dataset loss masks on independent outputs.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Variant of the UCF joint run that adds MultiSolSegment with masked sigmoid losses. Baseline: PF. Metrics: E1 relF1@2, crack IoU. Kill if no gain over the UCF-only joint arm of >= 0.01 relF1@2.

alt_notes.adaptation: UCF-EL, MultiSolSegment, BenchmarkEL in one run with sigmoid outputs and dataset-specific loss masks; union-class loss for UCF from the Bevandic row.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Extension of the UCF joint run adding MultiSolSegment with masked channels; same baseline (PF) and kill line as the Bevandic arm.

alt_notes.adaptation: Add 5 per-source crack sigmoid channels (optionally per-source inactive) beside the 24-class softmax; each cell trains only its source channel; at test read the image's source channel. The same head admits UCF-EL 'crack' (a crack+inactive region class) and MultiSolSegment classes as their own channels for joint training without overwriting the thin-crack convention.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm A: per-source crack channels on house PF, 5 seeds vs house PF 5 seeds; clean-49 crack IoU and per-source CV crack IoU; kill if gain < +0.012. Arm B: + UCF-EL joint training with its own channel; metric E1 crack relF1@2 and recall; kill if E1 relF1@2 gain < +0.03.
